newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 8.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Police were aware that outlawed Corsican National Front of Liberation (FLNC) was threatening to plant bombs in Bordeaux, Marseille and Lyon. FLNC claimed responsibility of a bomb attack on Saturday against Prime Minister Alain Juppe's mayoral offices in Bordeaux.
-- Belgian Credit Communal/Gemeentekrediet (CCB) and Credit Local de France create equity venture to be named Dexia.
-- Savings banks Caisses d'Epargne decide not to bid for control of CIC bank and may consider change in status to a mutual bank to allow for external growth and alliances.
-- Carmakers, public works groups and intermediate goods manufacturers most hard hit by sluggish economy, show lower results.
